## Original generation prompt

```text
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE complete premium wide 2.5:1 GitHub README hero banner proposal for Tilvero, a native macOS utility. Use input image 1 as the ONLY CURRENT LOGO reference. Its logo is a thick vivid green rounded energy wave with two smooth hills separated by a deep rounded valley and round endpoints, on an ivory rounded app-icon tile. Preserve that wave's actual distinctive silhouette and proportions; do not replace it with a generic sine wave, heartbeat spike, mountain, letter M, power button, open-top square loop, battery or leaf. This is the current green WAVE identity, not the older power-switch identity. The logo should be crisp and recognizable. Verbatim copy: 'Tilvero'; 'Battery, power and activity.'; 'Swift 6'; 'macOS 26+'; 'Apple silicon'; 'Source preview'. Exactly three modern equal-height rounded metadata capsules with text-only labels Swift 6 / macOS 26+ / Apple silicon, consistent typography, rounding and spacing. Source preview is separate small quiet text, not a fourth capsule. Modern calm beautifully kerned sans-serif, precise alignments, spacious margins and excellent readability. No Offline, no download/DMG/App Store promises, no control/hardware claims, no telemetry or UI, no extra slogans or words, no watermark or concept letters/numbers. Retain the vivid green brand color close to #21A652; pale ivory, very light mint and dark graphite may support it. Art direction C: MIDNIGHT ENERGY. A deep graphite and near-black green canvas with a restrained soft green atmospheric halo at the right edge. Right half: one large satin-green current wave logo suspended in darkness, its exact distinctive two-hill/one-valley shape kept intact, lit with a gentle edge highlight, vivid yet not neon. Behind it, one faint broad translucent green ribbon echoes its curve and disappears into the dark; decorative form only, not a signal graph. Left half: generous warm-ivory Tilvero wordmark, subtitle in soft light gray, three matching restrained dark translucent rounded capsules in a single row, Source preview small underneath. A small canonical ivory current app-icon tile can sit above the title to anchor the exact brand. Cinematic but calm, superb contrast, expensive studio lighting, sparse composition, no stars, no neon tubes, no power symbol, no glass battery, no device, no waveform axes or numbers. The brand feels deliberate, focused and native to the Mac.
```
